title.zh: 查询相似图片聚类结果

descriptions.zh:
**请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解 PDS 的收费方式和[价格](~~425220~~)**。

使用此功能须开通增值服务图片处理功能。

查询相似图片聚类结果前，需调用 CreateSimilarImageClusterTask 接口创建相似图片聚类任务，拿到 task_id，通过 GetTaskStatus 接口查询该聚类任务是否成功。待聚类任务成功后，再通过 SearchSimilarImageClusters 接口获取相似图片结果。

><notice>
- 未执行聚类任务调用该接口返回空列表。
- 相似图片聚类任务是增量更新聚类结果。若本次聚类任务未完成，则返回上一次聚类结果。
></notice>
descriptions.en:
**Before you use this API, make sure that you understand the billing methods and [pricing](~~425220~~) of PDS.**

To use this feature, you must enable the image processing value-added service.

To query for similar image cluster results, you must first call the CreateSimilarImageClusterTask API to create a clustering task and obtain its task\_id. Then, call the GetTaskStatus API to confirm that the task has succeeded. You can then call the SearchSimilarImageClusters API to retrieve the results.

><notice>

\- If you call this API before a clustering task has run, the API returns an empty list.
\- Similar image clustering tasks update clustering results incrementally. If the current clustering task is not yet complete, the API returns the results from the last successful task.

></notice>
